Class GameController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am28.Controller.GameController
public class GameController extends Object
The GameController class handles the dispatching of client-triggered events to the GameModel

    • reconnectClient

      public List<StateDTO> reconnectClient(String nickname, VirtualView clientView) throws Exception
      Reconnects a client to the game by associating the provided VirtualView with the given player nickname. It updates the game model to reflect the reconnection and returns the resulting game state updates.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the player to reconnect
      clientView - the VirtualView instance representing the client's network protocol
      Returns:
      a list of StateDTO objects representing the updated game state
      Throws:
      Exception - if the reconnection process encounters any issue

    • gameConfig

      public StateDTO gameConfig(String nickname, PlayerColor playerColor, int level, int numPlayers, VirtualView clientView) throws IllegalStateException, IllegalArgumentException
      Configures the game with the provided player details and game settings.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the player to be added to the game
      playerColor - the PlayerColor representing the color choice of the player
      level - the difficulty level of the game (0 and 2 are the supported levels)
      numPlayers - the total number of players for the game
      clientView - the VirtualView instance representing the player's view
      Returns:
      the updated StateDTO representing the current state of the game after configuration
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the game configuration cannot be completed due to the current state
      IllegalArgumentException - if the provided parameters are invalid

    • addNewPlayer

      public List<StateDTO> addNewPlayer(String nickname, PlayerColor playerColor, VirtualView clientView) throws IllegalStateException, IllegalArgumentException
      Adds a new player to the game with the specified nickname, player color, and client view.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the new player to be added
      playerColor - the color associated with the new player
      clientView - the VirtualView instance representing the player's client Returns a List of StateDTO objects where:
      • the first element is always present and represents the response to the command,
      • the second element, if present, represents the new state of the game.
      Returns:
      a list containing the response and optionally the new game state
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the new player cannot be added due to the current state of the game
      IllegalArgumentException - if the provided parameters are invalid

    • selectDeselectSubdeck

      public ConstructionDeckDTO selectDeselectSubdeck(String player, Integer selectedDeck, Boolean isSelectAction) throws IllegalStateException
      Allows a player to select or deselect a specific subdeck in the game.
      Parameters:
      player - the nickname of the player performing the action
      selectedDeck - the unique identifier of the subdeck to be selected or deselected
      isSelectAction - indicates whether the action is a selection (true) or deselection (false)
      Returns:
      a ConstructionDeckDTO containing the information about the selected or deselected subdeck
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the action is not allowed in the current state
